newsitem.title: USA: NYC says taxable debt sale remains at $120 million.
newsitem.headline: NYC says taxable debt sale remains at $120 million.

text.p: New York City, which is selling $900 million of tax-exempt bonds Wednesday, said the amount of taxable debt that will be sold competitively will remain at $120 million.

"The preliminary amounts in the notice of sale will constitute the revised amounts and bidders shall submit bids based on these revised amounts," said Public Resources Advisory Group, the city's financial adviser, in prepared remarks.
Another $50 million of variable-rate, taxable bonds will be sold to European investors.
